description:
One page of a region's tasks, ordered and filtered by the database.

The sorting, the timeframe filter and the search all happen in SQL, so a
long list costs one page rather than the whole table.

``sort_col`` names a column rather than supplying one: it indexes a fixed
map and falls back to the due date, so an unrecognised value gives the
default order rather than an error — and can never reach the query.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

region_id.description: The saved region whose tasks to list.

search.description: Optional POSIX regular expression, matched against title and note.

season_start.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD, so 'season' means the grower's season.

sort_col.description: due, title, done, starts, created or updated.

timeframe.description: day, week, month, season or all. 'season' means this farm's season.

name: goodearth_task_list
title: List tasks
